label: NQ Round Hundred Rejection 15m
researchSummary: NQ 15m round-hundred resistance rejection strategy filtered by a one-feature decision stump. The selected setup keeps short-only pre-NY rejections where the prior 15m close is still within 13.5 points below the same 100-point handle, matching the theory that clustered limit orders repeatedly defend those handles before rejection.
selectionMethod: Feature table built from completed round-hundred rejection candidates; a decision-stump gate over prior-close distance to the 100-point handle was widened from 13 to 13.5 points to increase trade count while keeping full-period profit factor above 2.
